body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> Hi-im Intertrade presented ''ARISTON'' USB-powered attachable stereo speaker for notebook-use during KES 2006. It is compatible with a monitor that ranges in size from 12~17 inches. The speaker has a storage for the USB cable on the back.

< AVING Special Report Team for ''KES 2006'': Publisher & Editor, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Caleb Ma, Jason Lee, Gaius Park, Phoebe Kwon, Sheri Choi, Joshua Shim, Daniel Sirh, Rose Kim, Paul Kim, Samuel Kim, Abe Shim, Grace Won >
